title: Gala deployment-intent contract

stableId.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv7. Once published, it is immutable; its time ordering conveys neither chronology nor authority.

repoRelativePath.description: NFC UTF-8 repository-relative path using slash separators, with no leading slash, dot segment, NUL, backslash, or percent-decoded traversal.

canonicalRoute.description: Absolute normalized route with no query, fragment, dot segment, double slash, or non-normalized percent encoding.

urlHttps.description: Absolute HTTPS URL without embedded credentials.

bcp47.description: Structurally valid canonical BCP-47 language tag.

isoCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; admission remains subject to the active policy profile.

plainLabel.description: Normalized Unicode plain text without markup, controls, or bidi overrides.

plainText.description: NFC Unicode text without disallowed C0/C1 controls or bidi override/isolate controls.

rfc3339.description: Canonical Gala UTC millisecond subset of RFC 3339.

semverRange.description: Whitespace-free npm-compatible exact, caret, or bounded comparator-set range; tags and URLs are invalid.

packageRange.description: Lowercase npm package identity and admitted semver range; Git, file, URL, and alias sources are invalid.

packageExact.description: Lowercase npm package identity and exact canonical semantic version; aliases are invalid.

urn.description: Absolute ASCII URN in the schema-declared Gala namespace.

glob.description: Repository-relative POSIX glob using only star, globstar, and question-mark operators; braces, extglobs, negation, absolute paths, and parent traversal are invalid.

extensionKey.description: Reverse-DNS extension namespace that cannot shadow a core key.

int64.description: Canonical signed 64-bit decimal string; range is checked by the semantic validator.

nonNegativeInt64.description: Canonical non-negative signed-64-bit decimal string; range is checked by the semantic validator.

environment.description: One constant per adapter (LOCAL-60a): `github-pages`, `do-spaces` or `local-directory`; it equals `adapterId` for each MVP adapter.

observedGenerationId.description: The generation the destination is observed to be serving. Unlike the write-side `expectedGenerationId` fence, this observation-side field is simply absent when nothing is served and may be carried as null by a consumer that models it nullably: an observation reports what is there, so "nothing" is a truthful reading, while an expectation of "nothing" must be stated as the explicit expect-nothing-served sentinel and can never be an omission (LOCAL-52).

publicProbeObservation.$comment: Plan equality, trusted timestamp order, redirect-chain selection, marker-specific generation presence, header-set equality, byte-count equality, and each evidence digest are enforced by the deployment semantic validator.

observedGenerationId.description: The generation the destination is observed to be serving. Unlike the write-side `expectedGenerationId` fence, this observation-side field is simply absent when nothing is served and may be carried as null by a consumer that models it nullably: an observation reports what is there, so "nothing" is a truthful reading, while an expectation of "nothing" must be stated as the explicit expect-nothing-served sentinel and can never be an omission (LOCAL-52).

activationDetectionProbe.$comment: Plan equality, trusted timestamp order, redirect-chain selection, marker-specific generation presence, header-set equality, byte-count equality, and each evidence digest are enforced by the deployment semantic validator.

generationFence.description: Activation fence: a generation identity, or the explicit expect-nothing-served sentinel. Never null, and never absent as a way of saying "no expectation" (LOCAL-47). This is the write-side expectation a caller states before it mutates a destination, and it is deliberately asymmetric with the observation-side fields (`observedGenerationId`), which are simply absent -- and are modelled as nullable by the in-process adapter protocol -- when nothing is served (LOCAL-52). It is deliberately one string schema with one combined pattern rather than a two-member `oneOf` of two string schemas: the admitted value set is identical, and OpenAPI Generator 7.25 turns such a union into an empty marker interface that a caller cannot carry a value in.

$comment: Every duplicate identity, marker member, authority coordinate, release/policy value, timestamp relation and digest is checked for byte equality or recomputed by the deployment-intent semantic validator.
